input_usuario: Qual o total da folha de pagamento em 2024?
query_referencia: WITH mensal AS (SELECT seq_dim_pessoa, CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(seq_dat_pagamento AS VARCHAR), 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS mes, MAX(CAST(vlr_rmn_liquida AS DECIMAL)) AS sal FROM remuneracao_municipio WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 GROUP BY seq_dim_pessoa, mes) SELECT SUM(sal) AS total_folha FROM mensal;
query_gerada: SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_rmn_liquida AS DECIMAL)) AS total_folha_pagamento FROM remuneracao_municipio WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND dsc_sit_serv_pens ILIKE '%Ativo%';
